engineered_features.transformation: extract hour-of-day from recorded time; out-of-range -> missing
engineered_features.justification: Hour of day (0-23) from the recorded collision time; risk and traffic mix vary through the day.
Cyclical encoding of hour so 23:00 and 00:00 are neighbours (helps linear models).
Month of year from collision date; captures seasonal effects.

engineered_features.transformation: ISO weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun from date (fallback: STATS19 day_of_week)
engineered_features.justification: Day of week (0=Mon..6=Sun) from date (falls back to the STATS19 day_of_week code).
Weekend flag; leisure traffic differs from commuter traffic.
Weekday 07-09 or 16-18; congestion lowers speeds but raises collision counts.
Hour >= 21 or < 6; proxy for reduced visibility and fatigue/impairment (approximate, ignores season).
Speed limit grouped (<=20, 30, 40-50, 60, 70, unknown); kinetic energy rises non-linearly with speed.
More than one vehicle involved; single-vehicle crashes have a different severity profile.
Weather codes collapsed to fine / rain / snow / high_wind / fog / other / unknown.
Surface codes collapsed to dry / wet / snow_ice / contaminated / unknown.
Light codes collapsed to daylight / dark_lit / dark_unlit / unknown.
Junction detail collapsed to no_junction / roundabout / t_junction / crossroads_multi / slip_road / private_drive / other / unknown.
Road type collapsed to roundabout / one_way_or_slip / dual_carriageway / single_carriageway / unknown.
